card.architecture: LongCat-Image-Edit Turbo (Meituan) — distilled 8-step variant of LongCat-Image-Edit. Flux-family MMDiT; Qwen2.5-VL encoder + Flux VAE; clip_type longcat_image. Q5_K_M GGUF.
card.summary: Distilled LongCat editor: ~8 steps at CFG 1 for fast drafts/previews. Same topology as the full model; trade a little fidelity for ~3x speed.
use_cases: quick previews before a full-quality pass
card.pick_when: You want quick edit iterations; switch to the full LongCat model for final quality.

prompt.guidance: Provide an input image + imperative instruction.
prompt.example: (with input image) Make it night time with neon signs
prompt.overview: Same instruction format as LongCat-Image-Edit; distilled for 8-step sampling at CFG 1 (negative ignored).

negative.note: Distilled, runs at CFG 1 so the negative is ignored.

speed.note: 8-step distilled; fastest of the LongCat pair.

ui_help.note: Fast instruction editing; lower fidelity than the full model.
